text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"विदेहानामिन्द्रियाणामभिप्रेतदेशकालविषयापेक्षो वृत्तिलाभो विकरणभावः","english":"Independence of the senses is the attainment of the activity of the senses, whether they are separated from the body or not","kind":"sense","why":"The source specifies 'videhānām' (of the bodiless/disembodied), but the translation adds 'or not', contradicting the specific condition.","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: Independence of the senses is the attainment of the activity of the senses, whether they are separated from the body or not
contradictions.why: The source specifies 'videhānām' (of the bodiless/disembodied), but the translation adds 'or not', contradicting the specific condition.
